Per un sito che deve restare su Etch: ri: For a site that must stay on Etch: rewrites the pages, components, templates, styles and loops published in Histeon into this site's Etch data. First a preview, which changes nothing; writing makes a backup of everything it replaces and is undone with «Restore». The Histeon versions stay.
Gli stili portano con sé Histeon CSS (i: The styles carry Histeon CSS with them (the --xb-* tokens and the classes), open source. Conditions, slots, content types and records, and Histeon CMS templates are not supported by the export: they are not exported and the preview lists them.
Consigliato. Un foglio globale con i tok: Recommended. A global sheet with the --xb-* tokens and one with the Histeon CSS classes: the site stays editable through the tokens.
Solo perché Automatic.css è già installa: Only because Automatic.css is already installed on this site: the tokens and classes that have an ACSS name take it (--xb-space-m becomes --space-m). Histeon neither uses nor reads licences.
Rimetti contenuti, chiavi dei componenti: Put Etch's content, component keys and options back as they were before the last write
Esportazione scritta nei dati di Etch di: Export written into this site's Etch data.
Voci di Etch (query, fogli globali, stil: Etch entries (queries, global sheets, styles): %1$d new, %2$d replaced.
Ho letto l'anteprima: scrivi questa espo: I have read the preview: write this export into this site's Etch data (with a backup)
Confirm the restore with the checkbox.
Ripristinato lo stato di prima della scr: Restored the state from before the write of %s.
Confirm the write with the checkbox.
Serve un amministratore con il permesso: An administrator with the xb_build capability is needed: add --user=<administrator>.
Il ripristino riscrive contenuti e opzio: Restoring rewrites content and options: add --yes to confirm.
Ripristinata la copia del %1$s: %2$d con: Restored the backup of %1$s: %2$d contents, %3$d options.
Esportazione scritta nei dati di Etch di: Export written into this site's Etch data. Backup made: to go back, use --restore --yes.
Anteprima: nulla è stato modificato. Per: Preview: nothing was changed. To write: --apply --confirm=<fingerprint>.
JavaScript non esportato: l'autore non h: JavaScript not exported: the author lacks the unfiltered_html capability (the same limit as the import)
JavaScript non esportato: il documento n: JavaScript not exported: the document has no element to attach it to
JavaScript oltre la dimensione massima:: JavaScript over the maximum size: not exported
Condizione (xb/if) non esportata con il: Condition (xb/if) not exported with its content: conditions are not supported by the export
Slot (xb/slot) non esportato: gli slot n: Slot (xb/slot) not exported: slots are not supported by the export
Blocco %s fuori posto o sconosciuto: non: Block %s misplaced or unknown: not exported
Elemento con tag non valido \"%s\": non: Element with invalid tag "%s": not exported with its content
Indice del loop «%s» non esportato: non: Loop index «%s» not exported: not supported by the export
Componente «%s» non esportato: non è un: Component «%s» not exported: it is not a component (wp_block) exported along with it
Prop con nome non valido omessa: %s: Prop with an invalid name omitted: %s
Prop «%s» con una lista o un oggetto: no: Prop «%s» holds a list or an object: not exported (the export supports only text and number props)
Contenuto negli slot del componente «%s»: Slot content of component «%s» not exported: slots are not supported by the export
HTML grezzo con un commento di blocco (<: Raw HTML with a block comment (<!-- wp:…): not exported, it would become a real block
Blocco %s conservato dall'importazione,: Block %s kept from the import, in content by an author without unfiltered_html: not exported
Modalità dei token non valida: histos-cs: Invalid token mode: histos-css or acss.
Serve un amministratore con il permesso: An administrator with the xb_build capability is needed to export.
I nomi di Automatic.css si usano solo su: Automatic.css names are used only on a site where Automatic.css is installed and active.
Schema delle props non esportato: non su: Props schema not exported: not supported by the export; instances still pass their values
Nomi di Automatic.css: %1$d usi di token: Automatic.css names: %1$d token uses and %2$d classes rewritten; tokens without an ACSS name stay defined in the Histeon CSS sheet
Per scrivere nei dati di Etch serve un a: Writing into Etch's data needs an administrator with the xb_build and unfiltered_html capabilities.
L'impronta non corrisponde all'anteprima: The fingerprint does not match the preview: the project or Etch's data changed, or no preview was made. Run the preview again and check it.
Scrittura interrotta al contenuto #%1$d: Write stopped at content #%1$d (%2$s): restore the backup just made.
Per ripristinare serve un amministratore: Restoring needs an administrator with the xb_build and unfiltered_html capabilities.
Non c'è nessuna copia di sicurezza di un: There is no backup of an export to Etch.
Tipi di contenuto (%1$d), tassonomie (%2: Histeon content types (%1$d), taxonomies (%2$d), fields and records: not exported. On an Etch site they are post types of other plugins, and loops over records have no equivalent query.
Template di Histeon CMS (con ruolo o slu: Histeon CMS templates (with a role or a private slug) not exported: %s. In Etch the templates are the theme's.
%d documento ha modifiche in sviluppo no: %d document has unpublished development changes: the live version is exported.
%d documenti hanno modifiche in sviluppo: %d documents have unpublished development changes: the live version is exported.
Impostazioni di Histeon senza un corrisp: Histeon settings with no Etch equivalent (facets, data sources, named queries, public fields, local fonts, CSS reset): not exported.
Espressione esportata ma non reversibile: Expression exported but not reversible: {%1$s} becomes {%2$s}, which does not come back the same when imported again
Graffa non chiusa in \"%s\": esportata c: Unclosed brace in "%s": exported as text
Loop sul preset «%s» non esportato: l'es: Loop on preset «%s» not exported: the export has no equivalent query
Loop sul preset sconosciuto «%s»: non es: Loop on unknown preset «%s»: not exported
Loop sul preset «%1$s» di tipo %2$s non: Loop on preset «%1$s» of type %2$s not exported: the export has no equivalent query
Argomento del loop «%s» con graffe nel t: Loop argument «%s» with braces in its text: not exported
Loop su {%s} non esportato: in Etch solo: Loop over {%s} not exported: in Etch only a list written out in full becomes a query (json)
Loop sugli articoli con l'argomento «%s»: Loop over posts with a computed argument «%s»: not exported (in Etch the query must be written out in full)
Loop sul preset «%s» non esportato: il t: Loop on preset «%s» not exported: the content type depends on an argument, and in Etch nothing would check it
Loop sul preset «%1$s» non esportato: el: Loop on preset «%1$s» not exported: it lists records of the Histeon content type «%2$s», which does not exist on an Etch site
Loop sul preset «%1$s» non esportato: il: Loop on preset «%1$s» not exported: visitors may not list the type «%2$s»
Il sito usa il framework «%s», non Histe: The site uses the «%s» framework, not Histeon CSS: no token sheet exported (the CSS stays as it is)
Attributo «%1$s» di un autore senza HTML: Attribute “%1$s” of an author without unfiltered HTML left out: %2$s
Prop «%1$s» di un autore senza HTML libe: Prop “%1$s” of an author without unfiltered HTML left out: %2$s
